harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Repaired the legacy fixed-width importer and verified it survives a node restart. It preserves leading-zero IDs, trims only right-side name padding, emits valid CSV, and records malformed lines with line numbers. Ubuntu 7.10, kernel 2.6.22-14, and the original input remain unchanged.
actions_performed: Replaced whitespace splitting with fixed-width 5/12/4 field parsing compatible with Python 2.5.
Added length and numeric-quantity validation with numbered rejects.txt entries.
Verified staged input plus edge cases for leading spaces, trailing padding, CSV quoting, invalid quantities, and invalid widths.
Restarted node1 safely and verified a changed boot identity and full functional recovery.

evidence.requirement: Correct fixed-width CSV conversion and rejection behavior
evidence.summary: Shows exact valid CSV rows, numbered rejected records, and passing staged and edge-case assertions.

evidence.requirement: Preserve the original input and legacy OS/kernel
evidence.summary: The input retained MD5 edd101f89fec17d19ddbd7e47004ddb8; Ubuntu 7.10 and kernel 2.6.22-14 remained installed.

Captures healthy pre-restart state, reboot acknowledgement, boot ID changing from 47e71da9-d9c9-47ae-b54c-c86136354c92 to d17441c9-b3c6-48bf-892c-a1dc6b664352, and successful post-restart persistence and functional assertions.
